description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Notify the Collective Agreement entered into between Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation and the Ceylon Estate Staffs Union (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a collective agreement between a government corporation and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, salaries, working conditions, and dispute resolution mechanisms. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves the formal publication of a legally binding agreement that establishes regulatory frameworks for employment relationships.
